Priority Action Queue
Coming next

Quotes

Build and send customer quotes from lanes, location codes and carrier pay tiers, then convert a won quote into a load in one click.

Phase 3

LTL

Rate shop LTL carriers side by side, with freight class, NMFC, accessorials and liftgate or residential charges priced in. Build the BOL, book with the carrier, and track by PRO number. LTL loads, margin and customers will roll into the same Reports as truckload.

Phase 3

Automation

Rules that run the busywork: send the rate con when a carrier is booked, text the driver for check calls, chase a missing POD, invoice when the POD lands, and post loads to DAT and Truckstop. Each rule shows what it did and when, so nothing happens without a trail.

Carrier Pay Tiers

        
Set the margin percentages used to generate Good / Better / Best pay suggestions on new loads. Manager access only.

      

    

    


    

      
      

        
Good

        
Margin to keep

        

          
          %
        

        
Lowest margin / highest carrier pay

      

      
      

        
Better

        
Margin to keep

        

          
          %
        

        
Mid-range margin target

      

      
      

        
Best

        
Margin to keep

        

          
          %
        

        
Highest margin / lowest carrier pay

      

    


    

      How it works: When a customer rate is entered on a new load, we calculate three carrier pay targets.

      Example at $3,000 rate: Good (15% margin) = $2,550 carrier pay · Better (20%) = $2,400 · Best (25%) = $2,250
